run_pytest_with_main: run pytest tests using the main entry point with verbose output and isolated test data
run_pytest_with_sharding: run pytest tests across multiple shards using TEST_TOTAL_SHARDS and TEST_SHARD_INDEX environment variables
run_pytest_with_debug_level: run pytest tests with a configurable debug level for diagnosing test failures
run_pytest_with_extra_args: run pytest tests passing additional command line arguments via the extra_pytest_args parameter
review_main_pytest_runner: review the main pytest runner function that handles sharding, debug levels, and empty test suite warnings
